name: Coming Soon
summary: Public editorial launch or maintenance page with a required heading, optional decorative media, real Link destinations, and a target-owned native form composed from Input and Button.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Full-page composition root; use the standalone main landmark in a target page or a labelled contextual section inside documentation.

anatomy.name: background
anatomy.description: Optional decorative full-page media; essential information remains textual.

anatomy.name: brand
anatomy.description: Optional brand composition containing a logo or store name.

anatomy.name: logo
anatomy.description: Optional target logo inside the brand composition.

anatomy.name: storeName
anatomy.description: Optional textual brand name inside the brand composition.

anatomy.name: inner
anatomy.description: Container-responsive layout wrapper that preserves editorial-first source order.

anatomy.name: editorial
anatomy.description: Editorial region containing the required heading and optional supporting content.

anatomy.name: heading
anatomy.description: Non-empty visible page heading and render precondition.

anatomy.name: social

anatomy.name: formRegion

anatomy.name: formHeading
anatomy.description: Optional visible heading for the form composition.

anatomy.name: formDescription
anatomy.description: Optional instructions presented before the form controls.

anatomy.name: form
anatomy.description: Native target-owned form layout containing canonical Input and Button dependencies.

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Optional contextual footer metadata or legal content.

states.name: default
states.description: Neutral-surface page without decorative background media.

states.name: withBackground
states.description: Decorative-media presentation with a contrast scrim and inverse editorial text.

behavior.name: requiredHeading
behavior.description: A valid composition requires a non-empty visible heading; adapters omit the component instead of emitting an unlabelled page shell.

behavior.name: backgroundMedia
behavior.description: Atmospheric background media is decorative and cannot carry information absent from the textual page content.

behavior.name: linkComposition
behavior.description: Social destinations compose canonical Link, use truthful target-owned href values, and do not prevent native activation.

behavior.name: formComposition
behavior.description: The target form composes canonical Input and Button, preserves native validation and submission, and owns endpoint, pending, success, error, retry, analytics, and persistence.

behavior.name: intrinsicLayout
behavior.description: A named inline-size container switches from split layout to editorial-first stack without depending on the browser viewport or Studio host.

properties.name: backgroundMedia
properties.description: Optional decorative full-page media; essential information remains textual.

properties.name: brand
properties.description: Optional target-owned logo or store-name composition.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: Non-empty visible page heading and render precondition.

properties.name: socialLinks
properties.description: Optional canonical Link destinations with truthful target-owned href values.

properties.name: formHeading
properties.description: Optional visible heading for the form region.

properties.name: formDescription
properties.description: Optional form guidance presented before its controls.

properties.name: form
properties.description: Optional native form composed from canonical Input and Button; the target owns its service and response lifecycle.

properties.name: footer
properties.description: Optional contextual footer metadata or legal content.

accessibility: Require one non-empty visible heading and omit invalid required composition.
Use one main landmark in a standalone page; use a labelled contextual section in documentation or another existing main.
Treat atmospheric background media as decorative with empty alternative text and keep all essential information textual.
Preserve editorial-first source order when the layout stacks.
Compose social destinations from canonical Link with real href values and meaningful visible text or an equivalent accessible name.
Compose every value-entry control from canonical Input with a visible label, native type, native validation, and associated message.
Use a submit-capable canonical Button and leave pending, success, error, retry, endpoint, analytics, and persistence ownership to the target.
Emit form-region label relationships only when the visible label target exists and omit an empty form region.
Preserve legibility in forced colors and do not add page-owned motion.

web.notes: Implemented by target-agnostic page CSS plus canonical Input, Button, and Link composition.

shopify.notes: The public Coming Soon section maps target settings and a customer form; the independent password template is outside this contract.
